snippet.title: Eternal Evil - Official Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Console Release Date Trailer for Eternal Evil, a survival horror first-person shooter developed by Honor Games. Players will fight back against ghouls and enemies that have taken over a small town. Solve puzzles, use a plethora of weapons, and uncover the nature behind a gruesome event. Eternal Evil is launching on May 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S with the game being available now for PC (Steam).

#EternalEvil #Gaming #IGN
